decision_rule: R3/R4 definitions. Corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is attributed to the wrong site, is misdated (a job-board re-post stamp written as a posting date; an aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the cited row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count of postings, leads with an older fact, lacks the closing second-person question (opening lines; 'your' accepted, R4-A PowerSecure precedent), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged. 'listed <date>' passes when the date is on a stated row for that requisition and the quoted field (JSON-LD datePosted, UKG PostedDate, ADP postDate, ITN 'Posted') still shows it today; choosing JSON-LD over a board-list stamp is not an error. Undated pages dated by the read ('read November 2026' / 'read Nov 17, 2026') are accepted where the cited row's retrieved_date carries that month (validate_lines.py counts a row's retrieved date; same rule as R5-lines-A); checked for all 8 such lines (Girtz CWI, Power Pool page, Simplex, Falcon x2, Modern, Phoenix 8th St Tampa PDF, Pleasanton EHS: retrieved 2026-11-16/17). An undated page read today leading a dated 2026 fact is not 'leads with an older fact' (R4-A and R5-lines-A treat it the same way). Unreachable only if a source cannot be reached at all.
